status_note: The mechanical split is complete and byte-verified. S4 parity is no longer HOLD: CENTRAL released it and the S4 candidate capture exists at evidence/s4/ (exact-head capture, 18 matched original/split state pairs across the three S2 viewports). MATERIALIZED_PENDING_PARITY is retained because it is the gate-recognized S3 status and the accepted-parity artifact plus CENTRAL visual acceptance do not exist yet; validate-mechanical-split requires this status to stay pending unless status is ACCEPTED with an accepted-parity reference. Final acceptance is established by evidence/parity/accepted-parity.json, externally.

source_candidate.provenance_field_note: generation_input_head is the repository HEAD that was checked out when the mechanical split was generated locally. It is not the PR exact head and cannot be recorded here: the final PR head only exists after this file is committed, so embedding it would be self-referential and never true. The value is retained purely as historical generation provenance. Exact-head acceptance for this capsule is external to the capsule and is established by the GitHub PR record and CI at the PR head.
source_candidate.materializer: ephemeral local splitter (logic independently re-derived and asserted by tests/s3-roundtrip.test.mjs; no shared harness used or modified)

boundaries.note: character offsets into the UTF-8 string. The authority carries 41 multibyte characters (bytes 166996 vs chars 166955); extraction and reconstruction operate on the lossless UTF-8 string, and byte identity is asserted on the re-encoded buffer.

outputs_note: No split/assets/** directory was created. The authority references zero local file assets and zero external URLs: markup carries 12 data: URIs plus 5 #anchor hrefs, and the single inline script carries 1 data: fallback URI. Nothing is vendored and no relative URL is rewritten.

frozen_defects_preserved.note: The mechanical split extracts the authority's inline style and script verbatim, so all twelve frozen defects survive into the split outputs unchanged (D6's demo momentUrl input default lives on in split/index.html). They are intentionally not repaired in this CLEAN lane. D11 ledger linkage is issued separately via src/02_master/MST046/record.json in this same lane; the split itself cannot link the ledger.

parity_status_note: The S4 parity capture has been executed at an exact head: evidence/s4/ holds the exact-head candidate capture (harness release commits 9b043336598bab41d30258d39205293dc9117b4b and 288f355a9ab47b2ba94a2416a5876e54e46f2753, capture head 288f355a9ab47b2ba94a2416a5876e54e46f2753, CANDIDATE_PASS). The field keeps the gate-recognized value PENDING_EXACT_HEAD_CAPTURE because the accepted-parity artifact does not exist yet: validate-mechanical-split accepts this value only while status is not ACCEPTED, and flipping it to PASS would require the accepted artifact in the same commit. CENTRAL visual acceptance promotes both.
next_stage_note: S4 parity is released and captured as a CANDIDATE_PASS candidate at evidence/s4/, but the next stage for this capsule - S4 acceptance and the source_split_parity_pass flag flip - remains on HOLD pending CENTRAL direct visual acceptance of the 18 original/split pairs. This enum value is retained because it is asserted by the S3 round-trip contract (tests/s3-roundtrip.test.mjs T20i) and by the validator pairing above; the acceptance lane rewrites it. Ready/merge transitions remain owned by CENTRAL.
